buyer: Webinar program manager at a small professional education publisher.
job: Run recurring partner-led webinar series from topic selection to attendee handoff and replay retirement.
current_workaround: Calendars, speaker email, webinar provider dashboards and CRM spreadsheets.
record: Webinar series record linking episode brief, partner obligations, registration consent, attendance and follow-up disposition.
workflow: Reconcile attendance, handoff and replay lifecycle
wedge: Cross-provider series continuity and partner deliverable accountability, without hosting video.
why_pay: Reduce duplicate production work and unfulfilled partner commitments across a recurring series.
expansion: Series budgets, replay entitlements and partner portfolios.

competitors.name: Demio
competitors.facts: Direct webinar alternative includes event-series delivery and engagement tools; streaming is part of its offer and excluded from the proposed software.
competitors.price: Starter displayed $63/month paid monthly or $45/month paid yearly, one host and 50-attendee room. Currency not explicitly named; larger plan selectors were incomplete.

pricing.free_boundary: 14-day trial with sample data; no permanent hosted team tier.
pricing.paid_boundary: Persistent workflow, permissions, history and operational exports.
pricing.lifetime: Unsuitable for continuing hosted collaboration and support; setup fees would not count as MRR.

channel: CMX community and public association webinar calendars: invite program managers to a series-retrospective demonstration.
retention: Recurring episodes reuse partners, consent rules and attendance mappings.
moat: Reliable partner/series history across provider changes; limited moat if APIs remain generic.

cost.assumptions: Three publishers and 30 webinars/month; all streaming, recordings and marketing sends remain customer-funded. Cash operating estimate; excludes engineering, support, acquisition, tax and payment fees.
cost.drivers: Provider connectors and consent reconciliation; no broadcast infrastructure or audience acquisition.
cost.revenue_stage: Up to $300/month after revenue for monitored backups, queues and measured usage; expand caps only after margins are observed.

risks: Demio already combines series delivery and engagement tools.
Another operating layer may duplicate provider features.
global_limits: Consent, promotional email rules and recording permissions vary by country.
validation: Ten producers replay five webinars; seek three $99 pilots and reduced partner/attendance reconciliation time.
kill_gate: Stop if customers require us to supply streaming or contacts to obtain value.
score_rationale: Low hosting cost is possible only with customer-owned delivery; incumbent overlap is considerable.
evidence_confidence: medium; official competitor evidence only, customer demand unvalidated
